item.title: Graceful Shutdown and Production Readiness
item.description: An application that starts and serves traffic is not production-ready. Production readiness means it shuts down cleanly, handles spikes, recovers from transient failures, and gives you visibility into what it’s doing. This article covers the operational layer. Graceful Shutdown When Kubernetes terminates a pod, it sends SIGTERM. Without graceful shutdown, in-flight requests are killed mid-execution — users see 500 errors or dropped writes.
